curatedMovie.curiosityHook: With Garlic Jr. pursuing immortality and the world teetering near the dead zone, can Goku and his unlikely allies retrieve Gohan in time?
curatedMovie.description: Seeking immortality and vengeance for his father, Garlic Jr. gathers the dragon balls and abducts Goku's young son Gohan, forcing Goku, Kami, Piccolo, and Krillin to join forces before a dark dimension claims the earth.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, exciting, and easily digested, offering moderate emotional stakes and dynamic animated combat built for an effortless group watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Clocking in at a brisk 41 minutes, this animated fantasy delivers fast, high-stakes martial arts combat as iconic allies unite against a villain intent on eternal life.
